verdict.rationale: Several independent hands-on reports confirm Sentry can be self-hosted, via a git clone plus ./install.sh or a Helm chart, and some teams have run it for 8–10+ years at scale. Users describe it as rock-solid, though several note heavy resource needs, growing complexity, occasional upgrade breakage, and self-hosted releases lagging SaaS. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting documentation in the evidence pack, evidence that self-hosted reaches feature parity with SaaS, and a lighter-weight deployment path for small setups.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
